name: Pinós (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow saltire charged with a narrower black saltire.
history: The official flag of Pinós is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with a yellow saltire with arms of width 1/4 of the flag, and over it another saltire, black, with arms of width 1/12; approved on 5 July 1996.

features.role: saltire with arms of 1/4 of the width
narrower saltire of 1/12 over the yellow one
